Volvo is adding Apple Music to the infotainment systems of more than 2 million cars via an over-the-air software update. Details below.

Volvo Adds Apple Music Integration via OTA Update

According to Exame (via MacMagazine), Volvo announced it will add Apple Music to the infotainment systems of several models via an OTA update.

According to the press release on the automaker's website, "The software update will be available for the Volvo EX90, ES90, XC90, S90, V90, XC60, S60, V60, XC40, EX40, and EC40, covering model year 2020 and later." The release also noted, "Availability may vary by model."

To celebrate the integration, eligible Volvo owners who are new to Apple Music will receive a three-month free trial, while returning users who have been off the service for at least a month can get two months free upon re-subscribing.

Beyond standard Apple Music playback, the Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90 equipped with the optional Bowers & Wilkins sound system will support Dolby Atmos spatial audio. The new EX60 will also feature Apple Music built-in natively when deliveries begin this summer.

Volvo says the offer for up to three months of free Apple Music will be available through July 6, 2027. To see Volvo's full announcement, click this link.

Apple Music requires an active subscription. It costs $11.99 per month, with new subscribers getting their first month free.
